jsch generate --schema schema.json --out ./model --package model --type Username

exec go test -count=1 ./model

-- schema.json --
{
  "type": "string",
  "minLength": 3,
  "maxLength": 12
}
-- go.mod --
module example.com/userpkg

go 1.27
-- model/model_test.go --
package model

import (
	"encoding/json/v2"
	"testing"
)

func TestUsername_RoundTrip(t *testing.T) {
	in := []byte(`"alice"`)
	var u Username
	if err := json.Unmarshal(in, &u); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Unmarshal: %v", err)
	}
	if u != "alice" {
		t.Errorf("Unmarshal = %q, want %q", string(u), "alice")
	}
	out, err := json.Marshal(u)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Marshal: %v", err)
	}
	if string(out) != `"alice"` {
		t.Errorf("Marshal = %s, want %s", out, `"alice"`)
	}
}

// minLength / maxLength are validation concerns enforced by
// jsonschema.Validate, not the generated unmarshaler. Out-of-bounds
// values decode structurally without error.
func TestUsername_NoLengthValidation(t *testing.T) {
	for _, in := range []string{`"hi"`, `"abcdefghijklmnop"`} {
		var u Username
		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(in), &u); err != nil {
			t.Errorf("Unmarshal(%s): %v", in, err)
		}
	}
}
